instruction: Single Storey Event Pavilion IFC And Revit Plan Sheet PDF This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. In Revit, create a single-storey event pavilion, export the model as result.ifc, and export a one-page Revit plan sheet as result.pdf in the Desktop. 1. The output folder contains result.ifc and result.pdf; result.ifc is at least 500 bytes and result.pdf is at least 200 bytes. 2. Result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema. 3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique. 4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 1 IfcBuildingStorey, 3 IfcSpace entities, 4 IfcWall entities, 1 IfcSlab, 1 IfcRoof, 1 IfcDoor entity, and 3 IfcWindow entities. 5. The IFC model contains 0 IfcStair, 0 IfcColumn, 0 IfcBeam, 0 IfcCurtainWall, and 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy entities. 6. After replacing hyphens and underscores with spaces and lowercasing names, the IfcSpace name list contains the token event at least once, storage at least once, and toilet at least once. 7. Result.pdf contains exactly 1 page exported from a Revit sheet. 8. The extracted text from result.pdf contains the case-insensitive tokens A101 PAVILION PLAN, Event Room, Storage, and Toilet. Any item not explicitly required may vary.
